answer: Graduated tenure vesting resists sybils: an identity's influence vests slowly along a long age ramp and decays toward zero without recent activity, so freshly spawned heads enter at an inlet of near-zero weight and only mature after a sustained voyage through the warmup horizon. A farm must carry k heads through the full ramp at once, paying upkeep for the whole window before any yields weight, and there is no oasis of instant standing. An honest agent matures one identity through ordinary tenure. Precondition: the ramp is long relative to attack value and decay outpaces cheap idle holding.
